messages:
maria: Heads-up — nightly microbench flagged a weird mid-seqlen throughput cliff on Ampere nodes (seqlen 256-512). attaching quick summary.
perf-bot: Nightly run 2024-11-03 07:02 UTC uploaded: s3://perf-nightly/2180001111/ampere-midseq-report.json :white_check_mark:
sam: ugh. is this the same hotspot we saw in July (kv-shim + batch merge)?
maria: seems related but not identical. July reg was at seqlen 128. this one spikes at 256-512 with 1.8x latency and 30% lower samples/sec.
cheng: can you paste the microbench command you ran? want to repro locally.
maria: sure — harness invocation:
```
./bench_harness --arch ampere --model gpt-like --probe-seqs "64,128,256,384,512,1024" --batching-policy auto --kv-enabled true --iters 200
```
olga: quick glance at the profile shows heavy memcpy around KV load + softmax kernels. possible memory thrash when KV pages cross 512 boundary.
sam: also see autoselect picked the small-block matmul kernel for 256, whereas for 128 it picked the tiled kernel. maybe selector heuristic mis-ranked midseq.
maria: exact. selector logs: seqlen 256 -> kernel small_block_v2 (latency 9.2ms), tiled_v1 would be 6.1ms per probe (from historical bench). autotuner confidence low.
cheng: did autotune see enough samples for 256? if autotune timeout triggered fallback we might have stale perf numbers.
maria: autotune run shows 8 samples only before cutoff. runs around 30s each, so timer was 4min. we capped to 5 samples historically which is not enough for variance at these lengths.
perf-bot: Note: nightly harness uses default sample_count=5 and preemption window=300s.
olga: proposal: 1) increase samples for midseq bracket (192-512) to 12 in nightly, 2) add a quick regression check that compares candidate kernel latency vs fallback tiled_v1 for midseq and fails if >1.2x, 3) run targeted microprobe sweep on Ampere with different mem alloc patterns.
sam: +1. Also add a KV-aware feature to selector: if kv_enabled && seqlen in mid-bracket prefer kernels with larger contiguous loads. simple heuristic first.
cheng: i'll write a patch to harness to: a) detect mid-bracket and bump sample_count b) emit extra perf artifacts `midseq-alloc-pattern.tar.gz` with pagemap. will open PR.
maria: thanks. can we get a one-off run tonight? if PR merges by 15:00 PT we can trigger manual job.
perf-bot: Manual job request queued: job id perf-2180001111-1. Estimated run time 2.5h on ampere-prod-pool.
olga: also flagging for eng-sre — this could impact Dedicated customers on Ampere if selector flips on rollout. we should gate any automatic rollout until we have regression checks.
sam: agreed. i'll add a gating rule to rollout pipeline: block if nightly midseq regression > 15% throughput drop compared to pinned baseline.
maria: action items: @cheng PR to harness (bump samples + artifacts), @sam add selector KV heuristic + rollout gate, @olga coordinate perf run and SRE notice. we'll reconvene after results. thanks all :thumbsup:
cheng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/bench_harness/pull/421 (contains tests + reproducer script).
perf-bot: Job perf-2180001111-1 started at 2024-11-03T22:10:00Z on ampere-prod-pool. Will post results when complete.
